name: Disembodied
traits: +2 Intelligence and +1 Dexterity. Choose the appearance and size of the humanoid you were before the accident. You weigh one-quarter of your former weight and have a 30-ft. walking speed. The origin grants no other traits.

Fade Away. As an action, enter the Ethereal Plane for up to 1 minute. You can move, hear, and see in grayscale. The Material Plane and anything on it cannot affect you and you cannot affect them. End the effect early as a bonus action. On return, use the nearest unoccupied space to the point where you disappeared. Recharges on a long rest.
Planar Outcast. Cast feather fall on yourself once per day. At level 3, cast blur once per day. At level 5, cast blink once per day. Intelligence governs these spells.
Arcane Origins grants Arcana proficiency. Speak, read, and write two languages of your choice.

name: Dreamer
traits: +2 Intelligence and +1 Constitution. Medium. Walking speed 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft.

Dreamwalking. While asleep you can touch the dreams of others within 1 mile. After a long rest that included sleep, choose one skill or tool. Add your proficiency bonus to rolls using that choice until your next long rest.
Even in Sleep. Sleep imposes no penalty on Perception checks that rely on senses other than sight.
Power Nap. Sleep for 1 hour during a short rest to reduce exhaustion by one level and regain one Hit Die in addition to the usual rest benefits.
Speak, read, and write Dreamspeak, Dwarvish, and one other language.

name: Laneshi
traits: +1 Strength and +1 Wisdom. Medium. Walking and swimming speeds 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., and can breathe air and water.
Beast Whisperers. Know speak with animals. Cast it once per day through this trait and regain that use after a long rest. Speak, read, and write Laneshi and one other language.

Warrior caste. Another +1 Strength, for +2 total. Gain proficiency with spears, tridents, javelins, light armor, and Animal Handling. After you hit a hostile creature with a weapon attack, you can Disengage as a bonus action before the end of that turn.

Mystic caste. Another +1 Wisdom, for +2 total. Resist psychic damage and roll Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves against magic with advantage. The first time Duality of Spirit activates after a long rest, also make a DC 12 Wisdom save or become stunned through the end of your next turn.
Laneshi Magic, available to the Mystic caste. Learn a necromancy cantrip and another necromancy cantrip at level 5. Wisdom governs both.

name: Ogresh
traits: +2 Charisma, +1 Constitution, and +1 Wisdom. Medium. Walking speed 30 ft.
Takes One to Know One. Advantage on saves against being charmed.
Powerful Build. Count as one size larger for carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.
Gift of Gab. Choose proficiency in two of Persuasion, Insight, Deception, or Performance.

A Friendly Ear. After speaking with a nonhostile creature for at least 1 minute, you can ask for a Wisdom save at DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier. On failure the creature is charmed by you for 1 hour and you learn one fact it knows about the topic, chosen by the DM. The creature remains unaware of the attempt either way. Recharges on a short rest.
Speak, read, and write three languages of your choice.

name: Wechselkind
traits: +2 Constitution and +1 Charisma. Small Humanoid, despite its artificial construction. Walking speed 25 ft. Immune to magical aging.
Artificial Form. Advantage on saves against being poisoned, resistance to poison damage, and immunity to disease. You have no need to eat, drink, sleep, or breathe.
Faerie Glamour. Once per long rest, cast disguise self using Charisma. Your only available guise is the specific child you were made to replace.
Childish Agility. Proficiency in Acrobatics. You can move through the space of any creature larger than you.
Speak, read, and write Sylvan and one other language.
